title: NorthSec Diamond - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: NorthSec 2025 badge team, Sao_Diamond, github.com/nsec/nsec-badge (MIT)
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected (as on the original), so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).
D1, D2: white reverse-mount LEDs on the back, shining through the board where NorthSec's two 3 mm through-hole LEDs stood.
One 1.3k resistor per LED (the original used 330 ohm on 3.3 V): about 0.45 mA each on badge power, about 0.2 mA each on a fresh cell.
